<h1>Hi! I'm Isabella. </h1>

I am an environmental data scientist with a Master's in Environmental Data Science. I am passionate about turning data into stories, action, and change. My background spans field research, water quality monitoring, program coordination, and quantitative analysis — including leveraging bird observations to evaluate California's 30x30 conservation framework. Ask me about agroecology and birds!
